# Law360 reports on Travis Lenkner's new role as Burford Capital's Chief Development Officer


- Law firm equity


September 16, 2024


-
-
-
-


Law360 reports on[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) 's new role as Burford's Chief Development Officer, including commentary from Burford CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) . Bogart notes that Lenkner has had "a tremendous impact" in legal finance, including during his previous time at Burford.


[Click here to read the full article](https://www.law360.com/classaction/articles/1879341/burford-capital-adds-chief-development-role-in-london) .
